recipe.visualDefinition: A central dark silhouette of a levitating figure with large, glowing white feathered wings, set against a heavily textured, olive-sepia background with vertical film scratches and a blurred horizon line.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the dark silhouette and the luminous white wings
Symmetry of the figure against the horizontal division of the ground and sky
Textural unity between the subject and the distressed background overlay
Verticality of the figure's pose echoed by vertical light streaks
coreInvariants: Muted olive-green and sepia color palette
Feathered wing texture with soft internal glow
Vertical scratch/film grain overlay across the entire frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical axis, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark torso of the silhouette provides the primary weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the dark center, move outward along the wings, and then upward to the top corners where text resides.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample space in the upper corners and lower foreground to allow for atmospheric depth and typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the wings and the silhouette.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and desaturated greens

letterConstructionRules: Classic proportions with moderate stroke contrast
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Lowercase serif for primary name vs. Uppercase spaced serif for title.

preserve: Wide tracking for the secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic, elegant serif structure of the primary text.
Suitable for the clean, uppercase secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark silhouette of a man in a long coat levitating, with large glowing white feathered wings spread wide. The background is a hazy, textured olive-green and sepia landscape with a blurred horizon. Apply a heavy vertical scratch texture and film grain over the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add lowercase serif text in the top left corner in white. Add uppercase serif text with wide tracking in the top right corner in a muted tan color. Ensure both are legible against the grunge texture.

verificationChecks: Is the silhouette central and levitating?
Are the wings glowing and feathered?
Is the texture heavily distressed with vertical lines?
Is the color palette muted and olive-toned?

adjustableVariables: Density of the vertical scratch texture
Warmth of the sepia color grade
Tracking width of the secondary text
mustRedesign: Specific band logos or symbols in the foreground shadow
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the silhouette remains dark and featureless
Verify the vertical scratches don't obscure the text legibility
Confirm the horizon line is soft and out of focus
recipe.reuseFormula: Central silhouette + Luminous wings + Grunge texture overlay + Classic serif typography = Ethereal Rock Aesthetic
